requirement: Verify EEG cache/index row alignment against windows array shape
pass_condition: index rows equal window count and required label/subject/video/fold fields are available
failure_action: stop and write cache-alignment failure report

requirement: Build all four feature sets without NaN/Inf
pass_condition: finite feature matrices for every feature_set_id in the spec
failure_action: stop and write feature-extraction failure report

requirement: Verify pairwise target construction for EEG/arousal only
pass_condition: within-subject pairs exist, balanced direction targets are possible, no cross-subject pair leakage
failure_action: stop and revise pair construction before training

pass_condition: any scaler/statistic fit is train-fold only and applied to validation fold without validation fitting
rows match spec matrix; no extra model/modality/task/formulation cells
failure_action: stop and correct matrix before future run

requirement: Validate no training metrics are produced by smoke test
pass_condition: smoke outputs are audits only; no model fit/prediction CSV from learned patch models
failure_action: stop and treat as protocol violation
